rules.cll-inclusion-proof: deterministic CBOR of [MMR node index of the leaf, [path nodes]]; the node index of zero-based leaf n is 2n - popcount(n)
rules.cll-consistency-proof: deterministic CBOR of [tree-size-1, tree-size-2, [one path per old peak], right-peaks]; right-peaks are the new peaks after the roots the old peaks' paths reach, adjacent repeats merged (MMR -02 §7.1)
rules.nodes: 32-octet byte strings, given here as lowercase hex
